summary.name: mitmproxy
summary.one_liner: mitmproxy is a free and open source interactive HTTPS proxy for intercepting, inspecting, modifying and replaying web traffic.
use_cases: debugging web and mobile app traffic
modifying requests before they reach the server
summary.what_it_does: mitmproxy intercepts, inspects, modifies and replays web traffic including HTTP/1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSockets and other SSL/TLS-protected protocols. It can prettify and decode message types ranging from HTML to Protobuf. Users can intercept specific messages on the fly, change them before they reach the destination, and replay them later. A graphical interface called mitmweb offers request interception and replay, and the Python API lets users write addons and script mitmproxy or mitmdump.
notable: Python addon API for scripting and modifying traffic
mitmweb graphical web interface with interception and replay
Supports HTTP/1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3 and WebSockets
caveats: Page does not list Windows or Linux platforms explicitly; the only install command shown is brew (macOS).
